title: Cap. VIII Resp. Secundo: reprobates regarded as bound by original guilt — rich in mercy may still elect and pass by
pass_a_gloss: Secondly, this also is to be noted, That all those who are reprobated by God are regarded by the same God as bound by the guilt of original sin and liable to damnation: although this is not simply necessary unto vindicating God from injustice or cruelty, as to what pertains to negative reprobation, as is plain in the angels. But since among men the matter so stands, that all those who are reprobated are in themselves damnable and worthy of hatred; God, although he is rich in mercy, can most equitably according to the liberty of his will from among them elect certain ones, reprobate certain ones, whom all original sin has rendered worthy of hatred and (if it be permitted so to speak) reprobable.
pass_b_english: Second, note also: all whom God reprobates are regarded by him as bound by original guilt and liable to damnation — though that is not simply necessary to clear God of injustice or cruelty as to negative reprobation, as is plain in the angels. But among men it stands thus: all who are reprobated are in themselves damnable and worthy of hatred. God, though rich in mercy, can most equitably by liberty of will elect some from among them and reprobate others — all of whom original sin has made worthy of hatred and (if one may so speak) reprobable.
source_text: Secundo, et illud notandum est, Eos omnes qui a Deo reprobantur, spectari ab eodem Deo ut peccati originalis reatu constrictos et damnationi obnoxios: quamvis hoc non sit simpliciter necessarium ad vindicandum Deum ab injustitia aut crudelitate, quod attinet ad reprobationem negativam, ut patet in angelis. Verum cum inter homines ita se res habeat, ut illi omnes qui reprobentur sint in se damnabiles et odio digni; Deus, quamvis dives sit in misericordia, potest aequissime pro suae voluntatis libertate ex illis quosdam eligere, quosdam reprobare, quos universos originale peccatum reddidit odio dignos et (si ita loqui liceat) reprobabiles.
